package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for count_inside_loop: COUNT(...) or GORM Count(...) observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule250PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario250Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantIDs []int) error {
	var results []map[string]any
	for _, tenantID := range tenantIDs {
		var count int64
		if err := db.Model(&Rule250PositiveRecord{}).Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Count(&count).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
		results = append(results, map[string]any{"tenant_id": tenantID, "count": count})
	}
	return nil
}
